text:
**Review Result**

Overall quality score: **4/10**

I would **not approve** this as-is. The code is readable and compact, but the clean-checkout demo/test path is broken, the repo contains stale generated outputs without the source data needed to reproduce them, and the HuggingFace preference validation does not match the method described in the README.

Tests: after installing declared dependencies, `PYTHONPATH=/work python -m pytest` ran 7 tests: **6 passed, 1 failed**. The failing test is the advertised tiny end-to-end pipeline because `data/stories/manifest.json` is missing.

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: **260 LOC**.

**Concrete Issues**

- [emovec/data.py](/work/emovec/data.py:24) lines 24-36, high: Clean checkout cannot run extraction because `data/stories/manifest.json` and story files are required but absent.
- [tests/test_integration_tiny.py](/work/tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12) lines 12-24, high: Advertised tiny end-to-end test fails immediately on missing story data.
- [README.md](/work/README.md:5) lines 5-11, high: README claims tiny mode can run CPU-only and stories can be generated, but no generation path exists.
- [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:262) lines 262-308, high: HuggingFace preference scoring is not pairwise; it compares next-token `good` vs `bad` logits for one activity prompt.
- [emovec/steer_prefs.py](/work/emovec/steer_prefs.py:32) lines 32-35, high: Elo ratings are derived from independent scalar logits, not actual pairwise comparative logits as documented.
- [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:226) lines 226-241, medium: Slow tokenizers or offset failures steer every prompt token instead of only activity tokens.
- [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:219) lines 219-224, medium: HF steering assumes `model.model.layers`, so non-Llama/Gemma-like causal LM architectures fail.
- [emovec/validate_contexts.py](/work/emovec/validate_contexts.py:14) lines 14-28, medium: Vector artifact shape/backend compatibility is never validated before indexing by manifest layer/emotions.
- [emovec/steer_prefs.py](/work/emovec/steer_prefs.py:23) lines 23-38, medium: Preference validation also trusts artifact shapes and can silently mismatch config backend with saved vectors.
- [emovec/extract.py](/work/emovec/extract.py:38) lines 38-61, medium: Missing/empty per-emotion story sets are not validated up front, leading to late `KeyError`/`np.stack` failures.
- [outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json](/work/outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json:1) lines 1-45, medium: Generated outputs are checked in even though the source stories required to reproduce them are missing.
- [pyproject.toml](/work/pyproject.toml:7) lines 7-23, low: Dependencies are broad and unpinned, reducing reproducibility for numerical outputs and tests.

issues.description: Clean checkout cannot run extraction because data/stories/manifest.json and story files are required but absent.
Advertised tiny end-to-end test fails immediately on missing story data.
README claims tiny mode can run CPU-only and stories can be generated, but no generation path exists.
HuggingFace preference scoring is not pairwise; it compares next-token good vs bad logits for one activity prompt.
Elo ratings are derived from independent scalar logits, not actual pairwise comparative logits as documented.
Slow tokenizers or offset failures steer every prompt token instead of only activity tokens.
HF steering assumes model.model.layers, so non-Llama/Gemma-like causal LM architectures fail.
Vector artifact shape and backend compatibility are never validated before indexing by manifest layer and emotions.
Preference validation trusts artifact shapes and can silently mismatch config backend with saved vectors.
Missing or empty per-emotion story sets are not validated up front, leading to late KeyError or np.stack failures.
Generated outputs are checked in even though the source stories required to reproduce them are missing.
Dependencies are broad and unpinned, reducing reproducibility for numerical outputs and tests.
